verdict.rationale: Context.dev's docs show that Scrape can return Markdown, HTML, a screenshot, images, or CSS-selected fields in one request, and that async crawls can return Markdown or HTML. That covers the core of selecting among output formats, but only some of the formats the story names are evidenced. Missing for 10: plain-text output, frontmatter output, explicit documentation of a format-selection parameter that returns exactly the chosen format, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can choose exactly which output format is returned, such as markdown, HTML, text, or frontmatter

citations.quote: Scrape a page into Markdown, HTML, a screenshot, images, or CSS-selected fields in one request.
retrieve Markdown or HTML when the job finishes
